captions.facebook:
AI can help a construction project before anything is built: layouts, materials, schedules, costs and process. I listed five uses and five questions to ask.

#AI #ConstructionTech

Would you trust AI with a building schedule?
captions.linkedin:
The cheapest place to fix a building problem is on the screen.

In construction planning, AI can help model layout options, coordinate materials, sequence work, project costs earlier and spot inefficiencies before they become expensive. AI-powered planning is one of the four pillars of BUILT®.

The questions I'd ask of any AI tool: What decision is it helping? What data does it use? Who checks the result? What does it cost to be wrong? How is it measured?
